name: theapps-mcp

tools.name: apps_help
tools.description: Apps-mcp bootstrap help: setup, safety, tool catalog, and the goal-specific skill to read before using another apps_* tool.

tools.name: apps_auth_status
tools.description: Show whether Apps API credentials are configured without returning secrets. Before the first apps_auth_status call in a task, read the skill matching the user's goal; use apps-connect for setup or authentication troubleshooting.

tools.name: apps_clear_token_cache
tools.description: Clear the in-memory access token cache so the next call refreshes the token. Before the first apps_clear_token_cache call in a task, read the apps-connect skill (SKILL.md and linked references as needed).

tools.name: apps_list_charges
tools.description: GET /v1/charge — list one-time (product) payments. Returns { items, has_more, mode, error }. payment.order_no is the order number supplied on the purchase URL when the plan keeps order numbers; it is not a payment_id. Response can contain personal data; return only fields needed for the user's request. Before the first apps_list_charges call in a task, read the apps-inspect-payments skill (SKILL.md and linked references as needed).

limit.description: Max items to return. When truncated, response.has_more may be true.

tools.name: apps_get_charge
tools.description: GET /v1/charge/{payment_id} — one-time payment details. payment_id is the top-level ID from a Webhook payment event, not the Webhook delivery id or an admin UI display id. A returned order_no is the merchant order number, not payment_id. Before the first apps_get_charge call in a task, read the apps-inspect-payments skill (SKILL.md and linked references as needed).

tools.name: apps_list_paid_payments
tools.description: GET /v1/paid — list subscription payments. Distinct from /v1/client/paid plan APIs. Returns { items, has_more, mode, error }. Response can contain personal data; return only fields needed for the user's request. Before the first apps_list_paid_payments call in a task, read the apps-inspect-payments skill (SKILL.md and linked references as needed).

limit.description: Max items to return. When truncated, response.has_more may be true.

tools.name: apps_verify_webhook_signature
tools.description: Verify Apps Webhook HMAC-SHA256 (Apps-Signature). Use the exact raw body before JSON parsing, never expose webhook_secret, and deduplicate with Apps-Webhook-Id or body.id rather than the signature. Before the first apps_verify_webhook_signature call in a task, read the apps-handle-webhooks skill (SKILL.md and linked references as needed).

raw_body.description: Exact raw HTTP body bytes as UTF-8 string (do not re-stringify JSON)

webhook_secret.description: Webhook secret from Apps API settings (whsec_...). Never log or commit.

webhook_id_header.description: Optional Apps-Webhook-Id; must equal body.id when provided
